_why: 3.9a 5: fire burns an enemy's Web. A zombie given Web (22 HP, so the fire does not end the fight) webs a wizard's spot from Close, then closes into its own patch (and is caught there); the wizard answers with Burning Hands. Fire on a creature in the patch burns it: one shared 2d4 fire to everyone standing there (the wizard included, the zombie again), the patch is cleared, every restraint it made ends, and the zombie's concentration on Web ends.
label: fight_library

stats.wizard_spell_4_desc: Burning Hands, a thin sheet of flame.
